description: Procurement for the supply of 1,900,000 Vials of Meropenem Injection 1g Vial
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the purchase of the Meropenem Injection, a drug used to treat a wide range of severe bacterial infections. Six (06) bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the procurement for the supply of 1,900,000 Vials of Meropenem Injection 1g Vial, to United Biotech (Pvt) Ltd, India (Manufacturer: United Biotech (Pvt) Ltd, India), the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum of USD1.99 million including total cost and freight charges, was approved by the Cabinet.
